> DigiXPro is an Independent Technology Architecture Advisory firm based in Noida, India.
> Founded by Dr. Ajay Shukla (20+ years in systems engineering), DigiXPro designs Business Operating Systems for growing organisations before they spend money on the wrong software.
> DigiXPro provides independent technology architecture advisory, custom web engineering, technical SEO, and AI/workflow automation systems.

### Operational Evidence (Case Studies)

- [Evidence Archive](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence): All client case studies and architecture reports.
- [Dr Aggarwal Physio Centre](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/dr-aggarwal): Healthcare OS + local SEO. #1 rank for physiotherapy in Greater Noida. Operates two clinic locations. Live sites: draggarwalphysiocentre.in and 360neckshoulder.com.
- [SattvaOS](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/sattvaos): Governed AI Infrastructure platform for high-trust organisations. Multi-tenant, policy-guardrailed, hallucination-free RAG.
- [Nirvandham](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/nirvandham): First production SattvaOS tenant — spiritual/cultural institution with multilingual AI guide, digital library, mobile app, and Muktibodh magazine pipeline.
- [Aatma Guru](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/aatma-guru): Organisation onboarding and tenant provisioning platform for SattvaOS ecosystem.
- [Scan Centre Near Me](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/scan-centre): Healthcare marketplace — multi-vendor scan centre discovery platform.
- [Muktibodh](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/muktibodh): Multilingual digital publishing and knowledge repository.
- [Buy Secondhand Books](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/buy-secondhand-book): Commerce OS — high-velocity used book marketplace with decoupled pricing engine.
- [DigiXPro (Self)](https://www.digixpro.in/evidence/digixpro): DigiXPro's own digital presence as a live architecture demonstration.
